language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Arrr! The name is Short Jack Gold. I am so close to finding my treasure! I have to solve the last two clues on my treasure map.
They read “take 23 – 10 ÷ 2 steps to the right and then (4 + 7) x (13 – 8) steps to the left and you will find your enormous treasure!”

backgroundLayers.text:
"take 23 – 10 ÷ 2 steps to the right
and then (4 + 7) x (13 – 8) steps to the left
and you will find your enormous treasure!"

dialog.text:
Hmm, how do I solve this?
- Brackets first
- x and ÷ next (from left to right)
- then + and – (from left to right)

Aye aye, let's start.
23 – 10 ÷ 2 = 23 – 5 -> ÷ is
solved before –
23 – 5 = 18.
This means I need to take 18 steps to the right.

(4 + 7) x (13 – 8) = 11 x 5
-> The brackets are solved
first
11 x 5 = 55
Next I take 55 steps to the left.
Hooray! I have reached the treasure!
